  • Method Details

    • consume

      @Modifying @Query("UPDATE UserRecoveryCode c SET c.usedAt = ?3\nWHERE c.idUser = ?1 AND c.codeHash = ?2 AND c.usedAt IS NULL") int consume(Integer idUser, String codeHash, LocalDateTime now)
      Spends a recovery code. Of two overlapping requests with the same code only one changes the row.
      Parameters:
      idUser - owner of the code
      codeHash - SHA-256 hash of the normalized code
      now - time of use, UTC
      Returns:
      1 when the code was valid and is spent now, otherwise 0
